Comment: Automated Bronze to Silver ETL Pipeline

Parameters.QueryString: INSERT INTO users_silver SELECT id, email, name, created_at, updated_at FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY id ORDER BY updated_at DESC) as rank FROM users_bronze) WHERE rank = 1;
INSERT INTO products_silver SELECT id, name, price, stock, reserved_stock FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY id ORDER BY updated_at DESC) as rank FROM products_bronze) WHERE rank = 1;

INSERT INTO carts_silver SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.status, COALESCE(SUM(ci.quantity * ci.price_at_addition), 0.0) FROM carts_bronze c LEFT JOIN cart_items_bronze ci ON c.id = ci.cart_id GROUP BY c.id, c.user_id, c.status;
